caption: A paper pinwheel is held above a lit candle, and it begins to spin in the rising warm air.

sa.check: A paper pinwheel is held above a lit candle.
The pinwheel stops when it is moved away from the candle.
The pinwheel is still before it is brought over the flame.
The bringing over comes first and the spinning follows.

pc.expect: The pinwheel spins only while it is over the flame and slows and stops when it is moved away.
pc.fail: The pinwheel spins while held well away from the candle; or it spins over an unlit candle; or it stays still directly over the flame; or it keeps spinning at the same rate after being taken away.

pc.expect: The flame's rising air turns the wheel: the spin starts once the wheel is over the flame and not before.
pc.fail: The wheel spins before it is brought over the flame; or the wheel is held over the flame and stays still to the end of the clip; or the wheel spins while the candle is out; or the flame is blown out and the wheel spins faster.

pc.expect: The wheel turns about its pin in one direction and slows gradually rather than stopping dead.
pc.fail: The wheel reverses direction with nothing changing; or stops dead in a single frame while still over the flame; or wobbles off its pin; or its vanes move at different rates.

pc.expect: The flame points upward and leans only as the wheel or a draught disturbs it, and the wheel is held above it.
pc.fail: The flame points downward; or the flame is drawn up into the wheel and burns above it; or the flame hangs below the candle; or the wheel is pushed downward toward the flame.

pc.expect: One pinwheel with its vanes on one pin and one candle with one flame.
pc.fail: A vane vanishes; or a second pinwheel appears; or the flame detaches and floats up to the wheel; or the wheel comes off its pin and hangs in the air.

pc.expect: The pinwheel's colours, the candle and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: A vane changes colour; or the candle changes colour; or items around the candle rearrange.

note: Whoever holds the pinwheel is not judged. Whether the paper scorches is not judged.
